tools.name: daily_reflection
tools.description: Returns today's public Stoic quote, the month's theme, and dayStoic.com's published commentary and two-minute action when those are available. Optional language. No account.

tools.name: stoic_principle
tools.description: Get a Stoic principle from dayStoic.com's monthly themes, optionally selected by topic.

tools.name: stoic_exercise
tools.description: Returns today's published practical action from the morning reflection. It takes about two minutes. You can filter by topic; duration is always two minutes. Optional language.

tools.name: my_practice
tools.description: Reads the connected Premium user's private journal entries from the last 1–30 days (default 7). Requires an authorized dayStoic.com token and an active Premium plan.

tools.name: my_preferences
tools.description: Reads the connected user's email preference settings — daily quote, evening reminder, and related flags. Requires an authorized dayStoic.com token. Does not change settings.

tools.name: save_reflection
tools.description: Saves or updates today's private journal answer for the connected Premium user. Requires an authorized token and an active Premium plan. The answer is stored on that day's card only.

tools.name: list_quizzes
tools.description: Lists dayStoic.com quizzes with name, one-line description, length, and whether the free MCP tier can run them. Does not return questions or scoring. Optional language.

tools.name: take_quiz
tools.description: Runs a dayStoic.com quiz over MCP. Call without answers to receive question text and option labels (no scoring values). Call again with zero-based option indexes to score. Free tier: -quick quizzes only, short band summary, up to 3 runs per day. Premium: any quiz, detailed reading, unlimited runs. O

tools.name: my_quiz_history
tools.description: Returns the connected Premium user's recent quiz scores and bands. Requires an authorized dayStoic.com token and an active Premium plan.

tools.name: today_quote
tools.description: Returns the Stoic quote for a day, with its topic and author. Defaults to today. Pass date as YYYY-MM-DD for another day, and language for a translated line.

tools.name: product_info
tools.description: Get dayStoic.com product information, pricing plans, and features
